audit_metadata.milestone: Stage 3 Readiness Audit — Canonical Compatibility Matrix

required_inputs: Prediction error norm (float) from GenerativeSelfModel / CANN
Collision / wall-proximity events from unprivileged sonar array
Optional: battery / energetic load from HAL sensor slice
produced_outputs: 4 neuromodulator levels: DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh (scalars in [0.0, 3.0])

inputs_exist_on_canonical_organism.details: dt is passed into step_cognitive_cycle(); prediction_error is computed in self.self_model.update_with_observation(); min_obstacle_dist is in sensory.min_obstacle_dist; raw_sensors contains energy/thermal states.

outputs_integratable_without_redesign.details: NE and ACh can directly scale candidate perturbation noise in MPPI (sigma) or weight the epistemic exploration term in Active Inference (w_info). Precision pi can scale sonar covariance.

alters_existing_certified_behavior.details: YES. Altering candidate exploration noise or EFE weights (w_info) directly affects trajectory selection and candidate steering in both MPPI (Stage 3.3) and Active Inference (Stage 3.4), changing downstream actions.

requires_new_state_apis_buses.details: No new buses required. Can be instantiated as self.endocrine = EndocrineSystem() inside CarlAutonomousOrganismAgent, stepped synchronously in step_cognitive_cycle, and exposed in CognitiveCycleTelemetry.

produced_outputs: Adaptive torque compensation scalar (e.g. k_torque_scale in [0.8, 1.5])

inputs_exist_on_canonical_organism.details: Already computed at lines 286-297 of carl_autonomous_agent.py (ax_history, v_est, slip_ratio). HAL supports hal.set_friction(mu) via MuJoCo geom friction override.

outputs_integratable_without_redesign.details: The adaptive torque scale can multiply the action command in step_embodiment() or scale wheel drive commands prior to hal.step().

alters_existing_certified_behavior.details: YES. Closed-loop torque scaling changes physical wheel velocity and slip dynamics across all environments.

requires_new_state_apis_buses.details: State (self.slip_ratio, self.v_est) already lives on the organism instance. Only a closed-loop gain policy (e.g., gain scheduling on slip_ratio) needs to be added.

required_inputs: Source grid coordinate (src_x, src_y) (integer index or robot pos)
Obstacle mask or occupancy grid (2D numpy array)
produced_outputs: Continuous gradient heading vector (atan2 angle in radians)

inputs_exist_on_canonical_organism.details: AllocentricRasterOccupancyMemory in self.spatial_memory contains the 2D grid; robot pose is in self.deliberation.pose[:2]; goal is in active_goal.target_coordinates.

outputs_integratable_without_redesign.details: High architectural friction. CarlAutonomousOrganismAgent operates via continuous trajectory rollouts (MPPI / Active Inference) evaluated against EFE. Physarum outputs a discrete 25x25 cell grid gradient. Bridging this requires converting the pressure gradient into an informative prior over continuous candidate generation or adding a Physarum distance potential into EFE scoring. Crucially, scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve takes 5-15 ms per step, which would push total cycle latency above the 20 ms real-time budget.

alters_existing_certified_behavior.details: YES. Adding a Physarum routing prior would fundamentally alter trajectory scoring across both mazes and dead-ends.

requires_new_state_apis_buses.details: Requires a raster-to-physarum bridge adapter, a background thread solver or downsampled grid to avoid latency violation, and a new interface on the deliberation engine to ingest global heading priors.

required_inputs: MuJoCo eye_cam RGB offscreen buffer (160x120x3 or 320x240x3)
produced_outputs: Active visual bounding boxes / optical flow cues
Target bearing and elevation in robot ego-frame

inputs_exist_on_canonical_organism.details: The hardware camera and joints exist in carl_vessel.xml. However, CarlStage1HAL does NOT initialize or step an offscreen mujoco.Renderer during 30 Hz simulation. Calling mujoco.Renderer(model, height, width).render() at 30 Hz takes 25-45 ms per frame on CPU/OpenGL, violating the 20 ms cognitive latency budget.

outputs_integratable_without_redesign.details: Major architectural redesign required. The canonical organism currently relies strictly on 15 unprivileged sonars, IMU gyro, and wheel encoders. Adding visual perception requires an asynchronous vision thread or low-frequency (2-5 Hz) visual cortex that projects 2D camera detections into 3D world rays and stamps them into the allocentric raster map without privileged coordinate leaks.

alters_existing_certified_behavior.details: YES. Modifies sensory perception, adds head motion commands (2 DoF) to the 6-channel motor bus, and alters occupancy mapping.

requires_new_state_apis_buses.details: Requires HAL camera frame buffer API, asynchronous renderer thread, camera-to-world raycaster, and head actuation controller.
